# MM-P2-L2-IH01-S1 Lubrication and fluids - Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01

Scope
- Defines lubrication and fluid handling requirements for Ring Rolling induction billet heater EQ-P2-L2-IH01.
- Applies to maintenance and operations technicians performing fluid servicing and coil inspection in support of safe heater operation.
- Refer to MM-P2-L2-IH01, SB-1024, and SOP-P2-L2-01 for electrical isolation, safety badges, and detailed lockout procedures.

Tools
- Clean drip pan compatible with specified lubricants.
- Lint-free rags and approved disposable wipes.
- Hand pump or dispensing nozzle compatible with CFW-LUB-938.
- Personal protective equipment per SB-1024 and SOP-P2-L2-01.

Procedure
- Verify completed isolation per MM-P2-L2-IH01 before any fluid work.
- Inspect coil and surrounding insulation for contamination or damage. Record coil inspection results and schedule per the coil inspection interval for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 365 hours.
- Remove contamination using lint-free rags and approved solvents per SOP-P2-L2-01. Do not introduce alternate fluids.
- Dispense lubricant CFW-LUB-938 into designated lubrication points using a clean pump or nozzle. Avoid over-application and wipe excess immediately.
- Reassemble covers and verify seals are seated. Return equipment to service only after completing the return-to-service checklist in MM-P2-L2-IH01.
- Document lubricant consumption and coil inspection findings in the equipment log and maintenance management system. Include references to SB-1024 for any safety incidents and SOP-P2-L2-01 for procedural deviations.

Acceptance criteria
- All lubrication points show even film of CFW-LUB-938 with no visible pooling or dripping.
- Coil inspection entries present in the log with date, technician initials, and condition statement, and inspections scheduled consistent with the coil inspection interval for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 365 hours.
- No contamination or foreign material remains on exposed coil surfaces and insulation.
- No outstanding safety items per SB-1024; procedural steps in SOP-P2-L2-01 followed and documented.
